activity.notes: Frege published Begriffsschrift in 1879 introducing modern quantificational logic and later developed foundational logic and philosophy of mathematics in Grundgesetze der Arithmetik (volumes 1893 and 1903) while teaching at Jena in the German Empire. This year-level interval covers his formative logic publications rather than all of his Jena appointment through retirement in 1917.
